title: How to take thyroid hormone pills
what: The pills replace the hormone your thyroid gland is missing. It is important to take them correctly, or they work less well.
why: When the thyroid gland is underactive or has been removed.
duration: a pill every day; a test to check the dose is usually done 6 to 8 weeks after a change
tell_doctor: All other medicines and supplements, especially iron, calcium and heartburn medicines
If you are pregnant or planning a pregnancy
If you have a racing heart, insomnia or severe weakness

prepare.title: Time
prepare.text: The pill is usually taken in the morning on an empty stomach, 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast. Ask your doctor.

prepare.title: Water
prepare.text: Take it with plain water, not coffee or milk.

prepare.title: Other medicines
prepare.text: Iron and calcium are usually taken a few hours after the hormone - your doctor will say exactly.

bring: A list of your other medicines
steps: In the morning, right after you wake up, take the pill
Drink it down with a glass of plain water
Wait before breakfast and coffee - usually 30 to 60 minutes
Take the pill every day at the same time
Do not change the dose on your own - only when your doctor decides
Have the hormone test when your doctor tells you
feel: Improvement usually comes gradually, over a few weeks
If the dose is too high, you may get a racing heart and nervousness - tell your doctor
after: If you missed it in the morning, ask your doctor what to do - do not take a double dose without advice
Keep the pills dry and at room temperature
Before the test, ask your doctor whether to take the pill before the blood draw
red_flags: A strong heartbeat or chest pain - call your local emergency number

faq.q: Can I ever stop taking the hormone?
faq.a: Only your doctor decides this. Often it is taken for life.

faq.q: Can I switch the brand of pills?
faq.a: It is better not to without your doctor. After a change the test is usually checked.

reminders.text: Good morning! Your thyroid pill - on an empty stomach, with plain water.
